description: Presidential Secretariat - Order by His Excellency the President Essential Public Services Act No. 61 of 1979
categorisation: This gazette content is a presidential order made under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It declares specific public transport and railway services to be "Essential Public Services" for the purposes of the Act. This constitutes a regulatory action that modifies the legal/regulatory framework by designating these services under special provisions of an existing law, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette (Type 5).
